Refinery.name: Volatiles Refinery
Refinery.description: A {2} x {2}, {0:F0} kg electric hearth and drying retort. Load one charge into its feed: a block of hydrates, clay hydrates or carbon ore, a block of meteoric iron, or four nickel-iron ingots with one carbon stock for steel. It draws {1:F0} kW while working, warms its room, and breathes the carbon charge's pyrolysis gas into the air, so keep a scrubber running. Solids go to its tray; water goes to a linked S3 or R3 vessel within one tile. A melt left waiting for a cool room too long freezes into slag.

Processor.name: Chemical Processor
Processor.description: A 2 x 2, {0:F0} kg water electrolysis cell. Each one-hour cycle at {1:F0} kW splits {2:F3} kg of water from a linked S3 or R3 vessel into {3:F3} kg of oxygen and {4:F3} kg of hydrogen. Oxygen goes into a linked O2 canister, or into the cabin air when none is linked; hydrogen goes into a linked H2 store. It runs only while every output has room.

Store.name: Hydrogen Store
Store.description: A 2 x 2, {0:F0} kg pressurised store for up to {1:F0} kg of electrolysis hydrogen. Passive: no power, no cargo. A damaged store leaks about {2:F0} kg an hour to space until repaired, and if the room holds oxygen and anything to light it, its contents burn. Keep it away from fire and working hearths, repair damage at once, and vent it before uninstalling.

Material.PhobosNickelIronIngot_descripti: A 4 kg ingot cast from meteoric iron as it comes: iron with a few percent of nickel and a trace of cobalt. Sound structural stock for machining, and the feed for carburised steel. Not steel by itself.
Material.PhobosCarbonStock_description: One kilogram of carbon driven out of carbon ore in the refinery. Melted in excess with four nickel-iron ingots it makes nickel steel.
Material.PhobosRefinerySlag_description: A kilogram of sulfide, phosphide and oxide slag skimmed from a cast, or a frozen melt broken out of the hearth. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosAnhydrousResidue_descript: Eight kilograms of baked clay minerals with their water driven off. Nothing recovers it.
Material.PhobosClayHydrates_description: A chunk of dark, water-rich clay minerals of the kind sampled from carbonaceous asteroids, about a fifth of it bound water. Bake it in a refinery for water; the government kiosks buy it like other ore.

Sabatier.name: Sabatier Reactor
Sabatier.description: A 2 x 2, {0:F0} kg catalytic Sabatier reactor: carbon dioxide and hydrogen into methane and water, CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O. Each one-hour cycle at {1:F1} kW takes {2:F3} kg of hydrogen from a linked store and {3:F3} kg of CO2 from an installed CO2 canister within one tile, and makes {4:F3} kg of water for a linked S3 or R3 and {5:F3} kg of methane for a linked methane store. The reaction gives off heat, so the room warms. Run with the X2 and the crew's scrubbed CO2 comes back as about half its water.

Methane.name: Methane Store
Methane.description: A 2 x 2, {0:F0} kg pressurised store for up to {1:F0} kg of Sabatier methane, kept until something aboard can use it. Passive: no power, no cargo. Methane crowds out the air you breathe and it burns: a damaged store leaks about {2:F0} kg an hour into the room until repaired, and with oxygen and anything to light it, its contents burn into carbon dioxide. Repair damage at once and vent it before uninstalling.
